checks.evidence: verify defaults: PASS finite, peak_db -7.17 dBFS, silent_edges -200/-200, dc -100 dB, rebuild bit-identical, macros brightness/pitch/grit all PASS. No FAIL.

time_shape.evidence: length 1.70 s (brief 0.8-2.5). Amplitude swells smoothly to a peak at 0.73 s (attack 0.68 s, loudness curve a smooth arch, no sharp transient); 22 onsets of 0.02-0.3 s spacing are the stick-slip pulses, none is an isolated loud hit. Edges silent (-200 dB), -20 dB decay 0.9 s.

spectrum.evidence: Spectrogram fundamental rises from ~270 Hz (t=0) to ~1 kHz (t=1.7), 2nd/3rd harmonics above it, i.e. inside 200-1500 Hz and clearly moving. YIN 569 Hz voiced 100 %, harmonicity 0.93. Centroid 505/767/1060 Hz start/mid/end; dominant bands 250 Hz then 500 Hz then 1 kHz (250 Hz -21.7 dB at 0-20 %, 500 Hz -17.0 dB at 40-60 %, 1 kHz -21.9 dB at 60-80 %). Little energy below 125 Hz (-50 dB) or above 8 kHz.

parts.evidence: Both named components are visible: a pitched stick-slip tone (harmonic ladder in the spectrogram, 11-22 onsets, grit=0 shows the clean sawtooth harmonic stack) and an audible pitch movement (rising ridge in all 4 seeds). No impact: no broadband onset at t=0 (0-20 % band 4k -52 dB, 8k+ -71 dB), first onsets are level 0.6 and the peak is mid-sound, not at the start.

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (brightness, pitch, grit), all claims PASS: brightness centroid 563->799 Hz, pitch 601->928 Hz, grit flatness rises (printed 0.000 throughout, at 3 decimals). Pitch sweep 0/0.5/1 gives YIN 442/569/713 Hz, all in 200-1500 Hz. 4 seeds differ: YIN 569/486/534/535 Hz, attack 0.68/0.88/0.79/0.77 s, onset counts 22/21/26/25, crest 11.3-12.6 dB, all 1.70 s with the same rising ridge.

notes: Every seed shows a visible step/kink in the fundamental around 0.75-0.9 s (near 500 Hz, with a loudness bump in the waveform); it looks like a pitch glitch that could be mistaken for an impact-like swell.

The grit macro at 0.5-1 turns the sound into noise: YIN voiced 3 % at 0.5 and 0 % at 1, harmonicity 0.45, so the pitched stick-slip is lost above ~0.5; the claim check printed flatness as 0.000 throughout, so it measures nothing at that resolution.
Seeds differ only mildly in contour (same ridge shape); variation is mostly in the pulse timing and the position of the kink.
